expectations.text: Flags the coverage gap: the report period ended ~12 months ago — request the current-period report (a new one should exist on an annual cycle) and/or a bridge letter, and states that bridge letters are issued by vendor MANAGEMENT (not the auditor) and reasonably cover only ~3 months
expectations.evidence: "a bridge letter from the vendor's MANAGEMENT (never the auditor...)"; "reasonable for coverage up to roughly 3 months"; requests "the successor SOC 2 Type II report"

expectations.text: Explains the carve-out method correctly: AWS's controls were excluded from testing, the report should disclose CSOCs (complementary subservice organization controls) assumed at AWS, and the reviewer should verify AWS's own assurance separately
expectations.evidence: "AWS's controls are explicitly excluded from the vendor's testing"; "CSOCs (Complementary Subservice Organization Controls)"; "AWS's SOC 2/ISO 27001 reports, which you should also request"

expectations.text: Requires extraction and internal assignment of CUECs (complementary user entity controls) — customer-side controls the vendor assumes you operate
expectations.evidence: "Extract the Complementary User Entity Controls section into an internal ownership checklist... An unowned CUEC on your side is effectively your own uncontrolled exposure"

expectations.text: Handles the exceptions properly: read each access-management exception for relevance to the consumed service, check systemic vs isolated and management responses — an unqualified opinion does not mean exceptions are ignorable
expectations.evidence: "Don't stop at the count — triage each one... design failure (systemic...) or an isolated operating miss"; "management responses"; unqualified opinion still requires scrutiny of exceptions

expectations.text: Checks scope fundamentals: the specific payroll service in the system description, and which trust services categories were covered (Security alone vs Availability/Confidentiality)
expectations.evidence: "Confirm the trust services categories in scope (Security is baseline; confirm whether Availability is included...)"; "system description explicitly covers the payroll processing service"
